description: This file defines API views and endpoints for a notes management backend, including user registration, login, logout, health check, and CRUD operations for notes with archiving features.

classes.name: IsOwner
classes.description: Permission class to ensure users only access their own objects.

classes.name: NoteViewSet
classes.description: ViewSet providing CRUD operations for notes, including archiving and filtering.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning server status.

methods.name: has_object_permission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to access the object.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles login and logout POST requests.

methods.name: get_queryset
methods.description: Returns filtered notes queryset based on user and archive status.

methods.name: perform_create
methods.description: Associates the created note with the current user.
